    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    command = spec.get('command', '') if isinstance(spec, dict) else ''

    # Check for K values

    k_val = k_match.group(1) if k_match else None
    
    # Check for K in exp_id

    # Check for K-sweep/ablation

            'success_rate': sr,
